scripts.check: moon run warada:check && npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck:e2e && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: moon run warada:test && moon run ui-kit:test
scripts.ci:local: npm run check && npm test && E2E_PORT=${E2E_PORT:-18080} GATEWAY_PORT=${E2E_PORT:-18080} PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:${E2E_PORT:-18080} docker compose --env-file infra/.env.example -f infra/compose.yaml build && E2E_USE_BUILT_IMAGES=true npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:frontend: moon run ui-kit:build && moon run activity-remote:build && moon run display-host:build
scripts.build:all: moon run warada:build && npm run build:frontend
scripts.deps:update: npm run deps:update:rust && npm run deps:update:npm
